name: @yceachan/pi-better-btw
description: Fork of nicobailon/pi-side-chat (https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-side-chat) — /btw (alias /side) forks the current conversation into a non-capturing side-chat overlay: read-only lane with lane enforcement, prompt pack, shared-prefix caching, mouse select
